Keep the app running in the background
Menu names can differ a little by model and version. These steps come from a community-maintained site and have not yet been checked on a phone.

string-array.name: brand_xiaomi_steps
string-array.item: Lock Mu\'mins DAY in the list of recent apps.
Open Settings > Apps > Mu\'mins DAY > App permissions and switch on \"Background autostart\". (The name may differ by version.)
Open Security > Battery > App Battery Saver > Mu\'mins DAY and choose \"No restriction\".

string-array.name: brand_realme_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings > Apps > Mu\'mins DAY (App info) and switch on \"Allow Auto Start-up\".
In App info > Battery usage, allow the app to run in the background.
Open Battery > Power saving settings > App battery management, allow auto-launch, foreground and background activity for this app, and keep battery optimisation off.
Open Apps > Special access and switch on \"Display pop-up windows of applications running in the background\" for alarm apps.
Avoid the phone\'s power-saving modes.

string-array.name: brand_tecno_steps
string-array.item: Lock Mu\'mins DAY in the list of recent apps.
Open Settings > Battery Lab > Battery Saving Settings and disable power saving management for apps.
Open Phone Master > Toolbox > Auto-start management and switch auto-start on for this app.
In Phone Master, open Power Marathon and turn off Power Boost.
In Phone Master > Advanced Settings, turn off \"Screen off push block\", \"Screen off sleep\" and \"Screen off scheduled push\".

string-array.name: brand_samsung_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings > Apps > Mu\'mins DAY > Battery > Battery optimization > All apps > Mu\'mins DAY and choose \"Don\'t optimize\".
Open Battery > Background usage limits, turn off \"Put unused apps to sleep\", and keep Mu\'mins DAY out of the sleeping lists.
Open Battery > More battery settings and turn off \"Adaptive battery\".
In Recent apps, long-press the app icon to lock Mu\'mins DAY, if your phone offers it.
Check these again after a system update: Samsung may switch them back.

string-array.name: brand_oppo_steps
string-array.item: Lock Mu\'mins DAY in the list of recent apps.
Open App info > Allow Auto Start-up and switch it on.
In App info > Battery usage, choose \"Run in background\".
In the Security app, allow Mu\'mins DAY in \"startup manager\" and \"floating app list\".
Turn off battery optimisation for this app.
In App info > Power Saver, pick the option that lets the app run in the background.

string-array.name: brand_vivo_steps
string-array.item: Lock Mu\'mins DAY in the list of recent apps (the \"lock\" or \"Lockdown\" option in its menu).
Open Settings > More settings > Applications > Autostart and switch on Mu\'mins DAY.
Open Settings > Battery > Background power consumption management (or \"High background power consumption\") and enable it for Mu\'mins DAY.
Open App Info > Battery > Battery Optimization and set Mu\'mins DAY to \"Not optimized\".
In the app\'s Battery page, if you can choose unrestricted battery usage, choose it.

string-array.name: brand_oneplus_steps
string-array.item: Lock Mu\'mins DAY in Recent apps: long-press the app window and tap the lock button.
Open Settings > Battery > Battery optimization, switch to \"All apps\", open Mu\'mins DAY and choose \"Don\'t optimize\".
In that menu, open the three dots > Advanced optimization and turn off \"Deep optimization\" and \"Sleep standby optimization\".
If \"App Auto-Launch\" exists on your phone, turn it off for this app.
Look at these settings again from time to time: OnePlus can switch them back.

string-array.name: brand_huawei_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, search for \"Battery optimization\", choose All apps, and set this app to \"Don\'t allow\".
Open Phone settings > Battery > App launch, turn off \"Manage all automatically\" and switch every toggle on.
Open Settings > All > Startup manager and allow Mu\'mins DAY.
In System Manager, tap the cog icon and turn off \"Smart tune-up\".

string-array.name: brand_motorola_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings > Apps > Mu\'mins DAY > App battery usage, tap the option with the toggle and choose \"Unrestricted\".
Open Settings > Battery and turn off \"Adaptive battery\".
In Mu\'mins DAY\'s app page > Advanced > Battery > Background restriction (or \"Background limits\"), tap \"Remove\" if it is restricted.
Search the settings for \"managing background apps\" and allow this app.
